recording.glass.found.text: So my glass found someone. Good.
recording.glass.found.source: So my glass found someone. Good.

recording.glass.keep.text: This glass keeps my words. Keep them with you, and listen again whenever you need to.
recording.glass.keep.source: This glass keeps my words. Keep them with you, and listen again whenever you need to.

recording.glass.gates.text: The world is in pieces now. Where the pieces meet, there are gates of my glass.
recording.glass.gates.source: The world is in pieces now. Where the pieces meet, there are gates of my glass.

recording.glass.open.text: They know my glass, and they open for whoever carries it. So carry it, and go on.
recording.glass.open.source: They know my glass, and they open for whoever carries it. So carry it, and go on.

recording.camp.tied.text: My old sword rose with one of my glasses, tied to it. Whoever finds it, it is yours.
recording.camp.tied.source: My old sword rose with one of my glasses, tied to it. Whoever finds it, it is yours.

recording.camp.honest.text: It is old and plain, but it is honest. It never broke on me.
recording.camp.honest.source: It is old and plain, but it is honest. It never broke on me.

recording.camp.listen.text: And listen for more of my glass. I will keep talking, for as long as I can.
recording.camp.listen.source: And listen for more of my glass. I will keep talking, for as long as I can.

robot.hello.there.text: Oh! Hello! Where am I? How did I end up in the grass?
robot.hello.there.source: Oh! Hello! Where am I? How did I end up in the grass?

robot.hello.glass.text: I cannot remember a thing, not even my name. Only that I am made of glass.
robot.hello.glass.source: I cannot remember a thing, not even my name. Only that I am made of glass.

robot.hello.come.text: Well, whoever you are, I will come with you. I can light the way.
robot.hello.come.source: Well, whoever you are, I will come with you. I can light the way.

robot.sword.take.text: And look, a sword, stuck in the ground right next to me! Take it, you will need it out there.
robot.sword.take.source: And look, a sword, stuck in the ground right next to me! Take it, you will need it out there.

robot.rock.up.text: Look, up on that rock! Something is glowing. It is glass, like me!
robot.rock.up.source: Look, up on that rock! Something is glowing. It is glass, like me!

robot.rock.important.text: I think glass like that is important, but I cannot remember why. And I do not remember any of it lying about out here.
robot.rock.important.source: I think glass like that is important, but I cannot remember why. And I do not remember any of it lying about out here.

robot.rock.snakes.text: We have to get up there! Watch out for the snakes at the bottom, and keep swinging.
robot.rock.snakes.source: We have to get up there! Watch out for the snakes at the bottom, and keep swinging.

robot.ladder.up.text: There is a ladder up the side of the rock. You climb, I fly!
robot.ladder.up.source: There is a ladder up the side of the rock. You climb, I fly!

robot.heard.voice.text: That voice! I know it from somewhere.
robot.heard.voice.source: That voice! I know it from somewhere.

robot.heard.maker.text: I think he made me, out of his glass. That is all I can find.
robot.heard.maker.source: I think he made me, out of his glass. That is all I can find.

recording.breath.begins.text: Every glass begins as a breath. Mine have, for forty years.
recording.breath.begins.source: Every glass begins as a breath. Mine have, for forty years.

recording.breath.slowly.text: You breathe out slowly, and the glass grows round your breath. Too fast, and it bursts in your face.
recording.breath.slowly.source: You breathe out slowly, and the glass grows round your breath. Too fast, and it bursts in your face.

recording.breath.master.text: My master said a glassmaker's lungs are his best tools. Then he coughed for an hour.
recording.breath.master.source: My master said a glassmaker's lungs are his best tools. Then he coughed for an hour.

recording.breath.small.text: I am old now, and short of breath. So I make my words small, and blow them carefully.
recording.breath.small.source: I am old now, and short of breath. So I make my words small, and blow them carefully.

recording.star-sand.left.text: Star-sand is what is left where a star came down. It is pale, and warm even in winter.
recording.star-sand.left.source: Star-sand is what is left where a star came down. It is pale, and warm even in winter.

recording.star-sand.wants.text: It wants to go back up. A glass made of it rises, unless somebody holds on to it.
recording.star-sand.wants.source: It wants to go back up. A glass made of it rises, unless somebody holds on to it.

recording.star-sand.boy.text: When I was a boy, I let one go by mistake. I watched it until it was a star again.
recording.star-sand.boy.source: When I was a boy, I let one go by mistake. I watched it until it was a star again.

recording.star-sand.old-craft.text: Nobody bought star-glass any more, by then. It was an old craft, for old men like my master.
recording.star-sand.old-craft.source: Nobody bought star-glass any more, by then. It was an old craft, for old men like my master.

recording.birds.workshop.text: My workshop stood at the edge of town, by the well. I made windows, mostly, and bottles.
recording.birds.workshop.source: My workshop stood at the edge of town, by the well. I made windows, mostly, and bottles.

recording.birds.children.text: Children stood at my window and watched the glass glow. Some of them stood there all day.
recording.birds.children.source: Children stood at my window and watched the glass glow. Some of them stood there all day.

recording.birds.blew.text: For the ones who stayed longest, I blew little birds. Wings out, as if they were just landing.
recording.birds.blew.source: For the ones who stayed longest, I blew little birds. Wings out, as if they were just landing.

recording.birds.windowsill.text: I wonder where those birds are now. I hope somebody still keeps one on a windowsill.
recording.birds.windowsill.source: I wonder where those birds are now. I hope somebody still keeps one on a windowsill.

recording.readers.tower.text: The star-readers lived on the hill, in a tower with no roof. They slept by day and read the sky by night.
recording.readers.tower.source: The star-readers lived on the hill, in a tower with no roof. They slept by day and read the sky by night.

recording.readers.pebbles.text: We thought them odd. Children threw pebbles at their door, and ran away laughing.
recording.readers.pebbles.source: We thought them odd. Children threw pebbles at their door, and ran away laughing.

recording.readers.once.text: I did too, once. I was not always old.
recording.readers.once.source: I did too, once. I was not always old.

recording.readers.fire.text: They never lit a fire up there, not even in winter. A fire, they said, makes you blind to the sky.
recording.readers.fire.source: They never lit a fire up there, not even in winter. A fire, they said, makes you blind to the sky.

recording.red-light.listened.text: When the star-readers spoke of the stone, nobody listened. Then we saw it ourselves.
recording.red-light.listened.source: When the star-readers spoke of the stone, nobody listened. Then we saw it ourselves.

recording.red-light.small.text: A small red light, low in the sky, that did not move with the others.
recording.red-light.small.source: A small red light, low in the sky, that did not move with the others.

recording.red-light.bigger.text: Every night it was a little bigger. People stopped going out after dark.
recording.red-light.bigger.source: Every night it was a little bigger. People stopped going out after dark.

recording.red-light.furnace.text: I kept my furnace burning all night, so I would not have to look up.
recording.red-light.furnace.source: I kept my furnace burning all night, so I would not have to look up.

recording.lanterns.night.text: They came at night, three of them, each with a lantern turned down low.
recording.lanterns.night.source: They came at night, three of them, each with a lantern turned down low.

recording.lanterns.handful.text: The oldest held out a handful of star-sand. She asked whether I could make a great deal of it rise.
recording.lanterns.handful.source: The oldest held out a handful of star-sand. She asked whether I could make a great deal of it rise.

recording.lanterns.yes.text: I said yes before I understood what she meant. I have always been too quick to say yes.
recording.lanterns.yes.source: I said yes before I understood what she meant. I have always been too quick to say yes.

recording.lanterns.looked-up.text: That night, for the first time, I looked up at the red light for a long while.
recording.lanterns.looked-up.source: That night, for the first time, I looked up at the red light for a long while.

recording.sea.hardest.text: The hardest piece to close was the sea. Water will not hold still to be measured.
recording.sea.hardest.source: The hardest piece to close was the sea. Water will not hold still to be measured.

recording.sea.low-tide.text: I closed the glass at low tide, round the beach, the shallows and a few small hills.
recording.sea.low-tide.source: I closed the glass at low tide, round the beach, the shallows and a few small hills.

recording.sea.tide-came.text: The tide came in anyway, inside the glass. It still does, twice a day, with nowhere to go.
recording.sea.tide-came.source: The tide came in anyway, inside the glass. It still does, twice a day, with nowhere to go.

recording.sea.hills.text: Whoever lives there learned to love the hills. I am sorry about that.
recording.sea.hills.source: Whoever lives there learned to love the hills. I am sorry about that.

recording.lines.chose.text: I did not choose the pieces. The star-readers drew lines on their maps, and I closed my glass along the lines.
recording.lines.chose.source: I did not choose the pieces. The star-readers drew lines on their maps, and I closed my glass along the lines.

recording.lines.here-there.text: A town here. A forest there. Half a mountain, because the line ran through it.
recording.lines.here-there.source: A town here. A forest there. Half a mountain, because the line ran through it.

recording.lines.between.text: I never asked about the places between the lines. What would become of them.
recording.lines.between.source: I never asked about the places between the lines. What would become of them.

recording.lines.every-night.text: I should have asked. I ask it every night now, down here.
recording.lines.every-night.source: [sad]I should have asked. I ask it every night now, down here.

recording.bread.kindness.text: People did not have to do anything. That is the kindness of star-glass: it closes round you, and you hardly notice.
recording.bread.kindness.source: People did not have to do anything. That is the kindness of star-glass: it closes round you, and you hardly notice.

recording.bread.baker.text: In one piece a baker went on baking. I could smell the bread through the glass.
recording.bread.baker.source: In one piece a baker went on baking. I could smell the bread through the glass.

recording.bread.keeps.text: Glass keeps what it holds. Even the smell of bread, even the morning it was baked.
recording.bread.keeps.source: Glass keeps what it holds. Even the smell of bread, even the morning it was baked.

recording.bread.hungry.text: I was hungry the whole time. I did not have a piece of my own.
recording.bread.hungry.source: I was hungry the whole time. I did not have a piece of my own.

recording.feathers.idea.text: The ark was the star-readers' idea, and its brass was the smiths' work. The wings were mine.
recording.feathers.idea.source: The ark was the star-readers' idea, and its brass was the smiths' work. The wings were mine.

recording.feathers.thousand.text: A thousand feathers of glass, each blown to want the sky a little.
recording.feathers.thousand.source: A thousand feathers of glass, each blown to want the sky a little.

recording.feathers.too-much.text: Too much, and the ark would never have come down. Too little, and it would never have gone up.
recording.feathers.too-much.source: Too much, and the ark would never have come down. Too little, and it would never have gone up.

recording.feathers.proud.text: I got it just right. I was proud of that, for a while.
recording.feathers.proud.source: I got it just right. I was proud of that, for a while.

recording.rising.page.text: When we rose, the ground turned away below us, slowly, like the page of a book.
recording.rising.page.source: When we rose, the ground turned away below us, slowly, like the page of a book.

recording.rising.up-down.text: After a while, up and down did not mean much. There was only towards the stars, and away from them.
recording.rising.up-down.source: After a while, up and down did not mean much. There was only towards the stars, and away from them.

recording.rising.smiths.text: The smiths were sick for days. I was not. Glassmakers are used to turning things.
recording.rising.smiths.source: The smiths were sick for days. I was not. Glassmakers are used to turning things.

recording.rising.lanterns.text: The pieces came up after us, through the clouds, like lanterns on a string.
recording.rising.lanterns.source: The pieces came up after us, through the clouds, like lanterns on a string.

recording.steam.huff.text: The ark breathed steam to steer. You could hear it all over the deck, a slow huff, like a sleeping horse.
recording.steam.huff.source: The ark breathed steam to steer. You could hear it all over the deck, a slow huff, like a sleeping horse.

recording.steam.kept.text: The smiths kept her boilers. The star-readers kept her charts. I kept the glass.
recording.steam.kept.source: The smiths kept her boilers. The star-readers kept her charts. I kept the glass.

recording.steam.lines.text: Every piece of the world hung under her on lines of light, and turned when she turned.
recording.steam.lines.source: Every piece of the world hung under her on lines of light, and turned when she turned.

recording.steam.slowly.text: When she turned too fast, everything we carried swung round with her. We learned to turn slowly.
recording.steam.slowly.source: When she turned too fast, everything we carried swung round with her. We learned to turn slowly.

recording.furnace.hold.text: I had a small furnace in the hold of the ark. Glass mends, if it is hot enough and you are quick.
recording.furnace.hold.source: I had a small furnace in the hold of the ark. Glass mends, if it is hot enough and you are quick.

recording.furnace.quick.text: I was very quick, in those days.
recording.furnace.quick.source: I was very quick, in those days.

recording.furnace.heat.text: Star-glass does not mind the cold, but it minds heat. Too hot, and it forgets what it holds.
recording.furnace.heat.source: Star-glass does not mind the cold, but it minds heat. Too hot, and it forgets what it holds.

recording.furnace.quarrel.text: So I kept the fire small, and the pieces far from it. Fire and glass are old friends, but they quarrel.
recording.furnace.quarrel.source: So I kept the fire small, and the pieces far from it. Fire and glass are old friends, but they quarrel.

recording.rigging.morning.text: Every morning I climbed the rigging to look at the pieces. The higher you climb, the more of them you see.
recording.rigging.morning.source: Every morning I climbed the rigging to look at the pieces. The higher you climb, the more of them you see.

recording.rigging.sound.text: A cracked pane has a sound of its own, high and thin. You learn to hear it over the wind.
recording.rigging.sound.source: A cracked pane has a sound of its own, high and thin. You learn to hear it over the wind.

recording.rigging.glowing.text: When I heard one, I went down to the furnace, and up again with the glass still glowing.
recording.rigging.glowing.source: When I heard one, I went down to the furnace, and up again with the glass still glowing.

recording.rigging.knees.text: Down and up, all day. My knees remember it better than I do.
recording.rigging.knees.source: Down and up, all day. My knees remember it better than I do.

recording.cracks.watch.text: Not every crack can be mended. Some you can only watch.
recording.cracks.watch.source: Not every crack can be mended. Some you can only watch.

recording.cracks.hold.text: But a crack is not a break. Star-glass can crack a hundred times and still hold.
recording.cracks.hold.source: But a crack is not a break. Star-glass can crack a hundred times and still hold.

recording.cracks.afraid.text: If you see cracks in the sky where you are, do not be afraid of them. I made that glass to hold.
recording.cracks.afraid.source: If you see cracks in the sky where you are, do not be afraid of them. I made that glass to hold.

recording.cracks.heat.text: It is the heat I worry about. Never the cracks.
recording.cracks.heat.source: It is the heat I worry about. Never the cracks.

recording.one-day.keeps.text: Glass keeps things as they are. That is why people trusted it, and why it frightened me a little.
recording.one-day.keeps.source: Glass keeps things as they are. That is why people trusted it, and why it frightened me a little.

recording.one-day.which.text: If I could keep one day the way my glass keeps things, I know which one I would keep.
recording.one-day.which.source: If I could keep one day the way my glass keeps things, I know which one I would keep.

recording.one-day.morning.text: The morning before the star-readers came. Bread, a cold window, and nothing to be afraid of.
recording.one-day.morning.source: The morning before the star-readers came. Bread, a cold window, and nothing to be afraid of.

recording.one-day.gives.text: But glass only keeps. It never gives anything back.
recording.one-day.gives.source: [sighing]But glass only keeps. It never gives anything back.

recording.clockworks.aboard.text: The star-readers brought little clockworks on board, with wings, to fly between the pieces and carry word.
recording.clockworks.aboard.source: The star-readers brought little clockworks on board, with wings, to fly between the pieces and carry word.

recording.clockworks.feathers.text: I made their glass, and their wings. Four feathers on each side, like a sparrow's.
recording.clockworks.feathers.source: I made their glass, and their wings. Four feathers on each side, like a sparrow's.

recording.clockworks.names.text: They ticked faster when they were happy. Some of them had names; I never learned them.
recording.clockworks.names.source: They ticked faster when they were happy. Some of them had names; I never learned them.

recording.clockworks.finding.text: I hope some of them still fly. They were very good at finding people.
recording.clockworks.finding.source: I hope some of them still fly. They were very good at finding people.

recording.evenings.best.text: On the ark, the evenings were the best part. The sun went down below us, not in front of us.
recording.evenings.best.source: On the ark, the evenings were the best part. The sun went down below us, not in front of us.

recording.evenings.gold.text: We sat on the deck, the smiths, the star-readers and I, and watched the pieces turn gold, one after the other.
recording.evenings.gold.source: We sat on the deck, the smiths, the star-readers and I, and watched the pieces turn gold, one after the other.

recording.evenings.stone.text: Nobody spoke of the stone. We had left it behind, or so we told each other.
recording.evenings.stone.source: Nobody spoke of the stone. We had left it behind, or so we told each other.

recording.evenings.stars.text: Then the night came, and with it the stars, more of them than I had ever seen.
recording.evenings.stars.source: Then the night came, and with it the stars, more of them than I had ever seen.

recording.cloth.last-day.text: On the last day before we rose, the star-readers brought one more thing on board, under a cloth.
recording.cloth.last-day.source: On the last day before we rose, the star-readers brought one more thing on board, under a cloth.

recording.cloth.carried.text: Four of them carried it, slowly, as if it might break. Or bite.
recording.cloth.carried.source: Four of them carried it, slowly, as if it might break. Or bite.

recording.cloth.needed.text: They said it was needed for the glass. They did not say for what.
recording.cloth.needed.source: They said it was needed for the glass. They did not say for what.

recording.cloth.sleep.text: They put it in the hold, next to my furnace. I did not sleep well, after that.
recording.cloth.sleep.source: They put it in the hold, next to my furnace. I did not sleep well, after that.

recording.face.slipped.text: Once, the cloth slipped. Behind the bars there was a face, and it was looking at me.
recording.face.slipped.source: Once, the cloth slipped. Behind the bars there was a face, and it was looking at me.

recording.face.people.text: Not the way an animal looks. The way people look, when they want to know what you are thinking.
recording.face.people.source: Not the way an animal looks. The way people look, when they want to know what you are thinking.

recording.face.on-show.text: The star-readers kept it like a thing on show, and talked about it in front of it, as if it were not there.
recording.face.on-show.source: The star-readers kept it like a thing on show, and talked about it in front of it, as if it were not there.

recording.face.sorry.text: I did not like that. I put the cloth back, gently, and said I was sorry.
recording.face.sorry.source: I did not like that. I put the cloth back, gently, and said I was sorry.

recording.jar.evening.text: Every evening a star-reader went down into the hold with an empty jar, and came back up with a full one.
recording.jar.evening.source: Every evening a star-reader went down into the hold with an empty jar, and came back up with a full one.

recording.jar.hummed.text: I never saw what was in it. It hummed, and the pieces shone brighter afterwards.
recording.jar.hummed.source: I never saw what was in it. It hummed, and the pieces shone brighter afterwards.

recording.jar.ask.text: I did not ask. In those days I thought it was not my place to ask.
recording.jar.ask.source: I did not ask. In those days I thought it was not my place to ask.

recording.jar.questions.text: Down here, I have had a long time to think of all the questions I did not ask.
recording.jar.questions.source: Down here, I have had a long time to think of all the questions I did not ask.

recording.hum.furnace.text: At night I kept my furnace low, and the thing in the hold hummed along with it.
recording.hum.furnace.source: At night I kept my furnace low, and the thing in the hold hummed along with it.

recording.hum.answered.text: I hummed back, to see what it would do. It answered, a little higher.
recording.hum.answered.source: I hummed back, to see what it would do. It answered, a little higher.

recording.hum.every-night.text: After that we hummed every night. The smiths thought I had gone strange.
recording.hum.every-night.source: After that we hummed every night. The smiths thought I had gone strange.

recording.words.hot.text: The first word it learned from me was hot. I said it every time I opened the furnace.
recording.words.hot.source: The first word it learned from me was hot. I said it every time I opened the furnace.

recording.words.more.text: Then glass, and sorry, and night. It learned faster than any apprentice I ever had.
recording.words.more.source: Then glass, and sorry, and night. It learned faster than any apprentice I ever had.

recording.words.my-voice.text: It said them in my voice, almost. That frightened me more than its face had.
recording.words.my-voice.source: It said them in my voice, almost. That frightened me more than its face had.

recording.mountain.asked.text: One night it asked me what a mountain was. It had never seen the ground from above.
recording.mountain.asked.source: One night it asked me what a mountain was. It had never seen the ground from above.

recording.mountain.standing.text: I told it a mountain is the ground, standing up to look at the sky.
recording.mountain.standing.source: I told it a mountain is the ground, standing up to look at the sky.

recording.mountain.story.text: It liked that. It asked for the mountain again every night, the way a child asks for a story.
recording.mountain.story.source: It liked that. It asked for the mountain again every night, the way a child asks for a story.

recording.charts.drift.text: Every night the star-readers marked the pieces on their charts. Every night the marks were a little further apart.
recording.charts.drift.source: Every night the star-readers marked the pieces on their charts. Every night the marks were a little further apart.

recording.charts.thin.text: The lines of light still held them, but they grew thin. I could see the stars through them.
recording.charts.thin.source: The lines of light still held them, but they grew thin. I could see the stars through them.

recording.charts.jar.text: So they went down with their jar more often. The humming in the hold grew quieter.
recording.charts.jar.source: So they went down with their jar more often. The humming in the hold grew quieter.

recording.lantern.tired.text: The oldest star-reader grew tired up there. She slept through the nights, and missed the stars.
recording.lantern.tired.source: The oldest star-reader grew tired up there. She slept through the nights, and missed the stars.

recording.lantern.gave.text: One evening she gave me her lantern. She said a glassmaker should have one light that is not a fire.
recording.lantern.gave.source: One evening she gave me her lantern. She said a glassmaker should have one light that is not a fire.

recording.lantern.still.text: I have it still, down here. It is the only light I do not have to feed.
recording.lantern.still.source: I have it still, down here. It is the only light I do not have to feed.

recording.quarrel.smiths.text: The smiths wanted the thing put off the ark. The star-readers said we would fall without what it made.
recording.quarrel.smiths.source: The smiths wanted the thing put off the ark. The star-readers said we would fall without what it made.

recording.quarrel.loud.text: They quarrelled on deck at night, loud enough to wake the pieces.
recording.quarrel.loud.source: They quarrelled on deck at night, loud enough to wake the pieces.

recording.quarrel.nobody.text: Nobody asked the thing what it wanted. Nobody asked me, either.
recording.quarrel.nobody.source: Nobody asked the thing what it wanted. Nobody asked me, either.

recording.why.asked.text: Once it had words enough, it asked me why it was kept in the dark.
recording.why.asked.source: Once it had words enough, it asked me why it was kept in the dark.

recording.why.whom.text: I said it was needed, and it asked: by whom? I had no answer I liked.
recording.why.whom.source: I said it was needed, and it asked: by whom? I had no answer I liked.

recording.why.thinking.text: I thought about that question all night, at the furnace. I am still thinking about it.
recording.why.thinking.source: I thought about that question all night, at the furnace. I am still thinking about it.

recording.hatch.see.text: It asked to see the stars, just once. It had heard us talk about them every night.
recording.hatch.see.source: It asked to see the stars, just once. It had heard us talk about them every night.

recording.hatch.inch.text: So I opened the hatch over the hold an inch, no more. Starlight fell in, a thin white line.
recording.hatch.inch.source: So I opened the hatch over the hold an inch, no more. Starlight fell in, a thin white line.

recording.hatch.still.text: It did not move all night. I have never seen anything keep so still.
recording.hatch.still.source: It did not move all night. I have never seen anything keep so still.

recording.left-open.after.text: After that I left the hatch open a little every night. Nobody noticed, or nobody said.
recording.left-open.after.source: After that I left the hatch open a little every night. Nobody noticed, or nobody said.

recording.left-open.eleven.text: It counted the stars it could see. Eleven, through an inch of sky.
recording.left-open.eleven.source: It counted the stars it could see. Eleven, through an inch of sky.

recording.left-open.wider.text: Sometimes I wonder whether I should have opened it wider. Or not at all.
recording.left-open.wider.source: Sometimes I wonder whether I should have opened it wider. Or not at all.

recording.boilers.hearts.text: The smiths fed the ark's boilers day and night. They called them her hearts.
recording.boilers.hearts.source: The smiths fed the ark's boilers day and night. They called them her hearts.

recording.boilers.anvil.text: Even up there they had an anvil. You could hear it ring out across the pieces.
recording.boilers.anvil.source: Even up there they had an anvil. You could hear it ring out across the pieces.

recording.boilers.harder.text: Brass or glass, which is harder to work? We argued about it every evening, and both of us were wrong.
recording.boilers.harder.source: Brass or glass, which is harder to work? We argued about it every evening, and both of us were wrong.

recording.songs.sang.text: The smiths sang while they worked, slow songs in time with the hammer.
recording.songs.sang.source: The smiths sang while they worked, slow songs in time with the hammer.

recording.songs.learned.text: The thing in the hold learned their songs too. It hummed them back, a little out of time.
recording.songs.learned.source: The thing in the hold learned their songs too. It hummed them back, a little out of time.

recording.songs.stopped.text: When the smiths heard it, they stopped singing. I never heard those songs again.
recording.songs.stopped.source: When the smiths heard it, they stopped singing. I never heard those songs again.

recording.frost.cold.text: High up it was cold, colder than any winter at home. Frost grew on the wings every night.
recording.frost.cold.source: High up it was cold, colder than any winter at home. Frost grew on the wings every night.

recording.frost.scraped.text: Every morning I scraped the feathers clean, one by one, before the sun could crack them.
recording.frost.scraped.source: Every morning I scraped the feathers clean, one by one, before the sun could crack them.

recording.frost.sound.text: A thousand feathers, every morning. I knew each one by its sound.
recording.frost.sound.source: A thousand feathers, every morning. I knew each one by its sound.

recording.little-bird.blew.text: One night I blew a little glass bird for it, like the ones I made for the children at my window.
recording.little-bird.blew.source: One night I blew a little glass bird for it, like the ones I made for the children at my window.

recording.little-bird.bars.text: I passed it through the bars. It held the bird the way you hold something that might fly away.
recording.little-bird.bars.source: I passed it through the bars. It held the bird the way you hold something that might fly away.

recording.little-bird.fly.text: It asked me whether glass could fly. I said only if you make it want to.
recording.little-bird.fly.source: It asked me whether glass could fly. I said only if you make it want to.

recording.cage.face.text: It kept the bird close to its face, and hummed to it.
recording.cage.face.source: It kept the bird close to its face, and hummed to it.

recording.cage.light.text: When the hold was dark, the bird caught the last of my furnace light.
recording.cage.light.source: When the hold was dark, the bird caught the last of my furnace light.

recording.cage.wings.text: It turned the bird round and round, and looked at its wings for a long time.
recording.cage.wings.source: It turned the bird round and round, and looked at its wings for a long time.

recording.fond.saw.text: The oldest star-reader saw the bird. She told me not to grow fond of the thing.
recording.fond.saw.source: The oldest star-reader saw the bird. She told me not to grow fond of the thing.

recording.fond.late.text: I told her it was too late for that. She did not smile.
recording.fond.late.source: I told her it was too late for that. She did not smile.

recording.fond.knew.text: I think she knew something I did not. I wish I had asked her what.
recording.fond.knew.source: I think she knew something I did not. I wish I had asked her what.

recording.calm.quiet.text: The night before the comets was the calmest of all. No wind, no quarrels, only the boilers breathing.
recording.calm.quiet.source: The night before the comets was the calmest of all. No wind, no quarrels, only the boilers breathing.

recording.calm.deck.text: Everyone was on deck, even the oldest star-reader. Nobody said why.
recording.calm.deck.source: Everyone was on deck, even the oldest star-reader. Nobody said why.

recording.calm.coming.text: I think we all felt something coming. We just did not know which way to look.
recording.calm.coming.source: I think we all felt something coming. We just did not know which way to look.

recording.promise.asked.text: That night it asked me to promise one thing: never to leave it alone in the dark.
recording.promise.asked.source: That night it asked me to promise one thing: never to leave it alone in the dark.

recording.promise.easy.text: I promised. It was an easy promise to make, up there, under all those stars.
recording.promise.easy.source: I promised. It was an easy promise to make, up there, under all those stars.

recording.promise.kept.text: I have kept it. Down here, it has kept me to it.
recording.promise.kept.source: [sighing]I have kept it. Down here, it has kept me to it.

recording.counted.pieces.text: Before I slept, I climbed the rigging and counted the pieces. They were all there.
recording.counted.pieces.source: Before I slept, I climbed the rigging and counted the pieces. They were all there.

recording.counted.last.text: It was the last time I saw them all together, hanging in the night like lanterns.
recording.counted.last.source: It was the last time I saw them all together, hanging in the night like lanterns.

recording.counted.number.text: I am glad I counted. I still know the number by heart.
recording.counted.number.source: I am glad I counted. I still know the number by heart.

recording.shower.night.text: The comets came at night, a whole shower of small ones. The star-readers had only ever looked for the one stone.
recording.shower.night.source: The comets came at night, a whole shower of small ones. The star-readers had only ever looked for the one stone.

recording.shower.beautiful.text: At first they were beautiful. Green and white, falling slowly, like sparks from a furnace.
recording.shower.beautiful.source: At first they were beautiful. Green and white, falling slowly, like sparks from a furnace.

recording.shower.wing.text: Then the first one struck the wing, and they were not beautiful any more.
recording.shower.wing.source: Then the first one struck the wing, and they were not beautiful any more.

recording.shower.still.text: Some of them still fall, I think, even now. Small ones, at night.
recording.shower.still.source: Some of them still fall, I think, even now. Small ones, at night.

recording.wings-broke.sound.text: A cracked pane sounds high and thin. That night, the whole sky made that sound.
recording.wings-broke.sound.source: A cracked pane sounds high and thin. That night, the whole sky made that sound.

recording.wings-broke.feather.text: My wings broke one feather at a time. I counted, and then I stopped counting.
recording.wings-broke.feather.source: My wings broke one feather at a time. I counted, and then I stopped counting.

recording.wings-broke.drifted.text: The lines of light went slack. The pieces drifted off, each its own way, like lanterns let go.
recording.wings-broke.drifted.source: The lines of light went slack. The pieces drifted off, each its own way, like lanterns let go.

recording.wings-broke.fell.text: I watched them go until I could not see them any more. Then we fell.
recording.wings-broke.fell.source: [sad]I watched them go until I could not see them any more. Then we fell.

recording.bottom.long.text: We fell for a long time. Past everything, below everything, into the dark.
recording.bottom.long.source: We fell for a long time. Past everything, below everything, into the dark.

recording.bottom.soft.text: We came down in something soft and cold, that held on to us the way mud holds a boot.
recording.bottom.soft.source: We came down in something soft and cold, that held on to us the way mud holds a boot.

recording.bottom.empty.text: When I woke, the hold was open, and the cage was empty.
recording.bottom.empty.source: When I woke, the hold was open, and the cage was empty.

recording.bottom.name.text: Then something in the dark said my name. It had learned it from me.
recording.bottom.name.source: [whispers]Then something in the dark said my name. It had learned it from me.

recording.hull.woke.text: I woke in the hull of the ark, lying on my back. Above me there was no sky at all.
recording.hull.woke.source: I woke in the hull of the ark, lying on my back. Above me there was no sky at all.

recording.hull.boilers.text: The boilers had stopped. For the first time in a year, nothing was breathing but me.
recording.hull.boilers.source: The boilers had stopped. For the first time in a year, nothing was breathing but me.

recording.hull.called.text: I called out for the others. Only my own voice came back.
recording.hull.called.source: I called out for the others. Only my own voice came back.

recording.only-light.lit.text: My little furnace had come down with me. I lit it with shaking hands.
recording.only-light.lit.source: My little furnace had come down with me. I lit it with shaking hands.

recording.only-light.burning.text: Down here it is the only light there is. Whatever happens, I keep it burning.
recording.only-light.burning.source: Down here it is the only light there is. Whatever happens, I keep it burning.

recording.only-light.dark.text: Star-glass minds the heat, but I mind the dark more.
recording.only-light.dark.source: Star-glass minds the heat, but I mind the dark more.

recording.crystals.glitter.text: In the furnace light the walls glittered. Crystals, everywhere, as tall as doors.
recording.crystals.glitter.source: In the furnace light the walls glittered. Crystals, everywhere, as tall as doors.

recording.crystals.grow.text: I think they grow from all the glass that ever fell this far. Some of it may be mine.
recording.crystals.grow.source: I think they grow from all the glass that ever fell this far. Some of it may be mine.

recording.crystals.company.text: They catch the light and give it back. It is a kind of company.
recording.crystals.company.source: They catch the light and give it back. It is a kind of company.

recording.voice.sentences.text: It speaks in whole sentences now, slowly, in a voice very like mine.
recording.voice.sentences.source: It speaks in whole sentences now, slowly, in a voice very like mine.

recording.voice.please.text: It is always polite, and it says please. Somehow that is the worst of it.
recording.voice.please.source: It is always polite, and it says please. Somehow that is the worst of it.

recording.voice.hurt.text: It has never once hurt me. It only will not let me go.
recording.voice.hurt.source: It has never once hurt me. It only will not let me go.

recording.walls.arms.text: It moves along the walls on long, soft arms. I hear it more than I see it.
recording.walls.arms.source: It moves along the walls on long, soft arms. I hear it more than I see it.

recording.walls.threads.text: It hangs threads of something from the rock, the way a spider would. I do not know what for.
recording.walls.threads.source: It hangs threads of something from the rock, the way a spider would. I do not know what for.

recording.walls.lower.text: When it comes near, my furnace burns lower. I have learned to feed it first.
recording.walls.lower.source: When it comes near, my furnace burns lower. I have learned to feed it first.

recording.bargain.build.text: It wants me to build something. In return it brings me food, and sand for my glass.
recording.bargain.build.source: It wants me to build something. In return it brings me food, and sand for my glass.

recording.bargain.wings.text: It wants to leave this place, and it cannot climb. So it wants wings.
recording.bargain.wings.source: It wants to leave this place, and it cannot climb. So it wants wings.

recording.bargain.yes.text: I said yes too quickly, as I always do. But what else could I have said?
recording.bargain.yes.source: I said yes too quickly, as I always do. But what else could I have said?

recording.lanterns-low.searched.text: I searched the whole hull for the others. I found their lanterns, still turned down low.
recording.lanterns-low.searched.source: I searched the whole hull for the others. I found their lanterns, still turned down low.

recording.lanterns-low.nothing.text: Nothing else. Whether they climbed out or were carried off, I do not know.
recording.lanterns-low.nothing.source: Nothing else. Whether they climbed out or were carried off, I do not know.

recording.lanterns-low.choose.text: I choose to think they climbed. A man needs something to choose.
recording.lanterns-low.choose.source: I choose to think they climbed. A man needs something to choose.

recording.bones.old.text: Down here lie the bones of things that fell long before us. Big things, and very old.
recording.bones.old.source: Down here lie the bones of things that fell long before us. Big things, and very old.

recording.bones.first.text: So we were not the first to fall this far. That should not comfort me, but it does.
recording.bones.first.source: So we were not the first to fall this far. That should not comfort me, but it does.

recording.bones.softly.text: I walk softly among them. It seems polite.
recording.bones.softly.source: I walk softly among them. It seems polite.

recording.names.furnace.text: Each night, before I sleep, I say the names of the smiths and the star-readers to my furnace.
recording.names.furnace.source: Each night, before I sleep, I say the names of the smiths and the star-readers to my furnace.

recording.names.keep.text: I do not blow their names into my glass. Names do not keep in glass.
recording.names.keep.source: I do not blow their names into my glass. Names do not keep in glass.

recording.names.fire.text: But the fire remembers them, I think, for as long as it burns.
recording.names.fire.source: But the fire remembers them, I think, for as long as it burns.

recording.ruins.town.text: Not far from the hull lie the ruins of a town that fell long ago. A whole piece of the world.
recording.ruins.town.source: Not far from the hull lie the ruins of a town that fell long ago. A whole piece of the world.

recording.ruins.windows.text: I take glass from its windows for the thing I must build. I always say sorry to the houses.
recording.ruins.windows.source: I take glass from its windows for the thing I must build. I always say sorry to the houses.

recording.ruins.nobody.text: Nobody lives there any more. I looked, and I was glad, and I was sorry.
recording.ruins.nobody.source: Nobody lives there any more. I looked, and I was glad, and I was sorry.

recording.wings-again.again.text: So I am making wings again. Smaller than the ark's, but they must carry more.
recording.wings-again.again.source: So I am making wings again. Smaller than the ark's, but they must carry more.

recording.wings-again.want.text: Every feather has to want the sky. This far from it, that is hard to blow.
recording.wings-again.want.source: Every feather has to want the sky. This far from it, that is hard to blow.

recording.wings-again.breath.text: Every glass begins with a breath. I give each feather a little of mine.
recording.wings-again.breath.source: Every glass begins with a breath. I give each feather a little of mine.

recording.slowly.work.text: I work slowly. It does not hurry me, but I work slowly all the same.
recording.slowly.work.source: I work slowly. It does not hurry me, but I work slowly all the same.

recording.slowly.after.text: Once it has its wings, I do not know what becomes of me. Or of it, up there.
recording.slowly.after.source: Once it has its wings, I do not know what becomes of me. Or of it, up there.

recording.slowly.master.text: My master said there is no shame in a careful glassmaker. I am being very careful.
recording.slowly.master.source: My master said there is no shame in a careful glassmaker. I am being very careful.

recording.first-bubble.accident.text: The first bubble I blew my words into was an accident. I spoke while I blew, and the glass kept it.
recording.first-bubble.accident.source: The first bubble I blew my words into was an accident. I spoke while I blew, and the glass kept it.

recording.first-bubble.another.text: I let it go, and it rose into the dark. That night I blew another, on purpose.
recording.first-bubble.another.source: I let it go, and it rose into the dark. That night I blew another, on purpose.

recording.first-bubble.hundreds.text: I have blown hundreds since. You are listening to one of them.
recording.first-bubble.hundreds.source: I have blown hundreds since. You are listening to one of them.

recording.fire-below.syrup.text: Below the hull the rock is hot, and in places it runs like syrup.
recording.fire-below.syrup.source: Below the hull the rock is hot, and in places it runs like syrup.

recording.fire-below.fast.text: My bubbles must rise fast, or the heat makes them forget what they hold.
recording.fire-below.fast.source: My bubbles must rise fast, or the heat makes them forget what they hold.

recording.fire-below.quiet.text: So I blow them when the rock is quiet, and let them go straight up.
recording.fire-below.quiet.source: So I blow them when the rock is quiet, and let them go straight up.

recording.who-hears.where.text: I never know where they come to rest. In a field, maybe, or a river, or somebody's pocket.
recording.who-hears.where.source: I never know where they come to rest. In a field, maybe, or a river, or somebody's pocket.

recording.who-hears.talk.text: I talk to whoever finds them as if I knew them. It is easier than talking to the dark.
recording.who-hears.talk.source: I talk to whoever finds them as if I knew them. It is easier than talking to the dark.

recording.who-hears.thank.text: If you have heard this many, thank you for listening.
recording.who-hears.thank.source: [whispers]If you have heard this many, thank you for listening.

recording.nearly.light.text: The thing I am building is nearly finished. Its wings catch my furnace light like water.
recording.nearly.light.source: The thing I am building is nearly finished. Its wings catch my furnace light like water.

recording.nearly.birds.text: It looks like the little birds I made for the children. I did not mean it to, but my hands did.
recording.nearly.birds.source: It looks like the little birds I made for the children. I did not mean it to, but my hands did.

recording.nearly.watches.text: It watches me work, and holds the little bird I gave it, all the time.
recording.nearly.watches.source: It watches me work, and holds the little bird I gave it, all the time.

recording.afraid.too.text: Last night it told me it is afraid of the dark too. It always has been.
recording.afraid.too.source: Last night it told me it is afraid of the dark too. It always has been.

recording.afraid.together.text: I did not know what to say. So I turned my furnace up, and we sat by it together.
recording.afraid.together.source: I did not know what to say. So I turned my furnace up, and we sat by it together.

recording.afraid.prisoners.text: Two old prisoners by one small fire. That is what we are now.
recording.afraid.prisoners.source: Two old prisoners by one small fire. That is what we are now.

recording.find-me.close.text: Some of my glass does not rise far. If you found this one deep down, you are close.
recording.find-me.close.source: Some of my glass does not rise far. If you found this one deep down, you are close.

recording.find-me.follow.text: Follow the heat and the dark. I will keep my furnace burning.
recording.find-me.follow.source: Follow the heat and the dark. I will keep my furnace burning.

robot.depth.1.sky.text: Down a well, and the sky is still up there! The pieces must hang one under the other.
robot.depth.1.sky.source: Down a well, and the sky is still up there! The pieces must hang one under the other.

robot.depth.2.voice.text: Every piece has a well, and every well goes down. I think that is where the voice in the glass comes from.
robot.depth.2.voice.source: Every piece has a well, and every well goes down. I think that is where the voice in the glass comes from.

robot.depth.3.counted.text: Three wells down! I counted. I am good at counting, when I remember to.
robot.depth.3.counted.source: Three wells down! I counted. I am good at counting, when I remember to.

robot.depth.4.warmer.text: It is warmer down here, or is that my core? Hard to tell.
robot.depth.4.warmer.source: It is warmer down here, or is that my core? Hard to tell.

robot.depth.5.further.text: The sky looks further away from here. Still blue, though.
robot.depth.5.further.source: The sky looks further away from here. Still blue, though.

robot.depth.6.last.text: This is the last piece under the open sky, I think. After this, the light only comes through cracks.
robot.depth.6.last.source: This is the last piece under the open sky, I think. After this, the light only comes through cracks.

robot.depth.13.dim.text: It is so dim down here. Good thing you brought me.
robot.depth.13.dim.source: It is so dim down here. Good thing you brought me.

robot.depth.13.wet.text: Something lives at the bottom of this piece. It sounds wet.
robot.depth.13.wet.source: Something lives at the bottom of this piece. It sounds wet.

robot.depth.7.lantern.text: No more open sky, only cracks of light. It is like being inside a lantern.
robot.depth.7.lantern.source: No more open sky, only cracks of light. It is like being inside a lantern.

robot.depth.8.hum.text: Do you hear that? The walls hum down here, as if something big is asleep.
robot.depth.8.hum.source: Do you hear that? The walls hum down here, as if something big is asleep.

robot.depth.9.halfway.text: I think we are about halfway. Halfway to what, I do not know.
robot.depth.9.halfway.source: I think we are about halfway. Halfway to what, I do not know.

robot.depth.10.counted.text: Ten wells down! I counted every one of them, I promise.
robot.depth.10.counted.source: Ten wells down! I counted every one of them, I promise.

robot.depth.11.warmer.text: The glassmaker's glass comes from below, I am sure of it now. It feels warmer, the deeper we go.
robot.depth.11.warmer.source: The glassmaker's glass comes from below, I am sure of it now. It feels warmer, the deeper we go.

robot.depth.12.brighter.text: It is getting darker. I will glow a little brighter, just for you.
robot.depth.12.brighter.source: It is getting darker. I will glow a little brighter, just for you.

robot.depth.14.dark.text: It is really dark now, no cracks, no sky. Stay where my light is.
robot.depth.14.dark.source: It is really dark now, no cracks, no sky. Stay where my light is.

robot.depth.14.braver.text: Good thing you have a lamp too. Two lights are braver than one.
robot.depth.14.braver.source: Good thing you have a lamp too. Two lights are braver than one.

robot.depth.15.hearth.text: The rock is warm down here, like a hearth after the fire went out.
robot.depth.15.hearth.source: The rock is warm down here, like a hearth after the fire went out.

robot.depth.16.below.text: If you listen, you can hear something far below. Like breathing, or a furnace.
robot.depth.16.below.source: If you listen, you can hear something far below. Like breathing, or a furnace.

robot.depth.17.fell.text: Everything down here fell from somewhere. I wonder if I did too.
robot.depth.17.fell.source: Everything down here fell from somewhere. I wonder if I did too.

robot.depth.18.close.text: My gears are ticking faster. I think we are close to something.
robot.depth.18.close.source: My gears are ticking faster. I think we are close to something.

robot.depth.19.last.text: One more well, the very last one. I am not ready, but I am coming with you.
robot.depth.19.last.source: One more well, the very last one. I am not ready, but I am coming with you.

robot.depth.20.bottom.text: This is it: the bottom of everything. The core.
robot.depth.20.bottom.source: This is it: the bottom of everything. The core.

robot.depth.20.furnace.text: If the glassmaker is anywhere, he is here. Can you smell a furnace?
robot.depth.20.furnace.source: If the glassmaker is anywhere, he is here. Can you smell a furnace?

robot.theme.meadow.text: Grass and flowers, all the way down! These pieces kept their summer.
robot.theme.meadow.source: Grass and flowers, all the way down! These pieces kept their summer.

robot.theme.clouds.text: We are walking on clouds! Do not tell them, they might stop holding us.
robot.theme.clouds.source: We are walking on clouds! Do not tell them, they might stop holding us.

robot.theme.lagoon.text: Islands and blue water. Something small in there is watching us.
robot.theme.lagoon.source: Islands and blue water. Something small in there is watching us.

robot.theme.karst.text: These rocks look like somebody poured them out and forgot to stop.
robot.theme.karst.source: These rocks look like somebody poured them out and forgot to stop.

robot.theme.peaks.text: Snow! I cannot feel the cold, but my gears tick slower.
robot.theme.peaks.source: Snow! I cannot feel the cold, but my gears tick slower.

robot.theme.highlands.text: Prayer flags. Somebody up here hoped very hard for something.
robot.theme.highlands.source: Prayer flags. Somebody up here hoped very hard for something.

robot.theme.badlands.text: Everything here is the colour of rust. I hope it is not catching.
robot.theme.badlands.source: Everything here is the colour of rust. I hope it is not catching.

robot.theme.saltflats.text: Salt, as far as I can see. I think this was a sea once, and the glass kept the salt.
robot.theme.saltflats.source: Salt, as far as I can see. I think this was a sea once, and the glass kept the salt.

robot.theme.canyon.text: Red walls on both sides, and the sky is only a stripe up there.
robot.theme.canyon.source: Red walls on both sides, and the sky is only a stripe up there.

robot.theme.darkforest.text: It is always night in this forest. Good thing I glow, so stay close.
robot.theme.darkforest.source: It is always night in this forest. Good thing I glow, so stay close.

robot.theme.slime.text: Ugh, everything sticks. Do not step in the green, it does not let go.
robot.theme.slime.source: Ugh, everything sticks. Do not step in the green, it does not let go.

robot.theme.roots.text: Roots, hanging from the ceiling! Something enormous is growing right above us.
robot.theme.roots.source: Roots, hanging from the ceiling! Something enormous is growing right above us.

robot.theme.grotto.text: A grotto full of water, and it glows. The light comes from under the water!
robot.theme.grotto.source: A grotto full of water, and it glows. The light comes from under the water!

robot.theme.forge.text: Anvils and chimneys! Somebody worked brass here, like the smiths on... something. I forget.
robot.theme.forge.source: Anvils and chimneys! Somebody worked brass here, like the smiths on... something. I forget.

robot.theme.hive.text: Everything here is honey and wax. It smells sweet, and it is very, very sticky.
robot.theme.hive.source: Everything here is honey and wax. It smells sweet, and it is very, very sticky.

robot.theme.swamp.text: Mushrooms taller than you! Do not touch the green water, it bites.
robot.theme.swamp.source: Mushrooms taller than you! Do not touch the green water, it bites.

robot.theme.cenote.text: A jungle, under the ground! And a round hole of sky, far up there.
robot.theme.cenote.source: A jungle, under the ground! And a round hole of sky, far up there.

robot.theme.frozen.text: Ice caves, and frost on my feathers! Somebody used to scrape frost off feathers like these, I think.
robot.theme.frozen.source: Ice caves, and frost on my feathers! Somebody used to scrape frost off feathers like these, I think.

robot.theme.mines.text: Crystals as tall as doors! They catch my light and throw it everywhere.
robot.theme.mines.source: Crystals as tall as doors! They catch my light and throw it everywhere.

robot.theme.nests.text: Webs everywhere, big ones. I would like to go home now, please.
robot.theme.nests.source: Webs everywhere, big ones. I would like to go home now, please.

robot.theme.ossuary.text: Bones, lots of old bones. They are very quiet, so let us be quiet too.
robot.theme.ossuary.source: Bones, lots of old bones. They are very quiet, so let us be quiet too.

robot.theme.ruins.text: A whole town, buried down here. Somebody lived in these houses, a long time ago.
robot.theme.ruins.source: A whole town, buried down here. Somebody lived in these houses, a long time ago.

robot.theme.volcanic.text: Lava, and it is so hot my glass tingles! Keep away from the glowing rock.
robot.theme.volcanic.source: Lava, and it is so hot my glass tingles! Keep away from the glowing rock.

robot.theme.abyss.text: Black glass all around. It looks like the night sky fell down here and froze.
robot.theme.abyss.source: Black glass all around. It looks like the night sky fell down here and froze.

robot.foe.snake.text: Snakes! They lunge when they bite, so step back when they rear up.
robot.foe.snake.source: Snakes! They lunge when they bite, so step back when they rear up.

robot.foe.spider.text: Spiders, a whole bunch. Do not let them get round you.
robot.foe.spider.source: Spiders, a whole bunch. Do not let them get round you.

robot.foe.stunder.text: That big one hits hard. Wait for its swing, then hit back.
robot.foe.stunder.source: That big one hits hard. Wait for its swing, then hit back.

robot.foe.wolk.text: A little cloud with lightning! When the ground under you crackles, step off it.
robot.foe.wolk.source: A little cloud with lightning! When the ground under you crackles, step off it.

robot.foe.squirtle.text: Squirtles! They hide under the water and pop up to spit at you.
robot.foe.squirtle.source: Squirtles! They hide under the water and pop up to spit at you.

robot.foe.tornado.text: A walking tornado! Its twisters throw you down, so step out of their way.
robot.foe.tornado.source: A walking tornado! Its twisters throw you down, so step out of their way.

robot.foe.flimmer.text: Those three flicker, and some blows go right through them. Hit them when they stop to punch.
robot.foe.flimmer.source: Those three flicker, and some blows go right through them. Hit them when they stop to punch.

robot.foe.shraps.text: That one throws ice. If it hits you, you go cold and slow.
robot.foe.shraps.source: That one throws ice. If it hits you, you go cold and slow.

robot.foe.triangle.text: A triangle with a temper! Its punches knock you over.
robot.foe.triangle.source: A triangle with a temper! Its punches knock you over.

robot.foe.wolla.text: A Wolla! Its storm blows you back, so step out of it sideways.
robot.foe.wolla.source: A Wolla! Its storm blows you back, so step out of it sideways.

robot.foe.octonaut.text: Arms everywhere! When it spins, back off.
robot.foe.octonaut.source: Arms everywhere! When it spins, back off.

robot.foe.mecked.text: Big ears, big teeth. Do not let it grab you.
robot.foe.mecked.source: Big ears, big teeth. Do not let it grab you.

robot.foe.moose.text: A whole herd of Moose! When one lowers its head, jump aside. And watch out for that tail!
robot.foe.moose.source: A whole herd of Moose! When one lowers its head, jump aside. And watch out for that tail!

robot.foe.fireface.text: A face made of fire! Its fireballs keep burning for a while.
robot.foe.fireface.source: A face made of fire! Its fireballs keep burning for a while.

robot.foe.firecat.text: A cat made of fire! It runs in and pounces, so keep moving.
robot.foe.firecat.source: A cat made of fire! It runs in and pounces, so keep moving.

robot.foe.slug.text: A slug that spits! The slime slows you down.
robot.foe.slug.source: A slug that spits! The slime slows you down.

robot.foe.bolime.text: Careful, that blob swallows things! If it gets you, walk and jump until you are out.
robot.foe.bolime.source: Careful, that blob swallows things! If it gets you, walk and jump until you are out.

robot.foe.spicy.text: A pepper with a laser! Step aside when it aims.
robot.foe.spicy.source: A pepper with a laser! Step aside when it aims.

robot.arena.gusto.teeth.text: Oh. Oh no. That one has a lot of teeth.
robot.arena.gusto.teeth.source: Oh. Oh no. That one has a lot of teeth.

robot.arena.gusto.arms.text: When it throws its arms wide, step back. If it grabs nothing, it falls flat on its face!
robot.arena.gusto.arms.source: When it throws its arms wide, step back. If it grabs nothing, it falls flat on its face!

robot.arena.totnar.sticks.text: A big ball of sticks, with skulls on top. And somebody lit fires all round the edge.
robot.arena.totnar.sticks.source: A big ball of sticks, with skulls on top. And somebody lit fires all round the edge.

robot.arena.totnar.dark.text: I think he likes the dark. If it goes dark, I will glow as bright as I can.
robot.arena.totnar.dark.source: I think he likes the dark. If it goes dark, I will glow as bright as I can.

robot.arena.squarlo.small.text: That little fellow? He is smaller than you!
robot.arena.squarlo.small.source: That little fellow? He is smaller than you!

robot.arena.squarlo.hills.text: Shells on the ground, and hills everywhere: this place floods. Remember the hills.
robot.arena.squarlo.hills.source: Shells on the ground, and hills everywhere: this place floods. Remember the hills.

robot.arena.flip.box.text: It is a box. We are in a box!
robot.arena.flip.box.source: It is a box. We are in a box!

robot.arena.flip.rings.text: Rings of light. I think he turns things upside down, so mind the floor, wherever it ends up.
robot.arena.flip.rings.source: Rings of light. I think he turns things upside down, so mind the floor, wherever it ends up.

robot.arena.foggery.hot.text: Lava all round, and a tower in the middle. Whoever lives here likes it hot.
robot.arena.foggery.hot.source: Lava all round, and a tower in the middle. Whoever lives here likes it hot.

robot.arena.foggery.climb.text: If the lava rises, climb. Do not stop to look at the view!
robot.arena.foggery.climb.source: If the lava rises, climb. Do not stop to look at the view!

robot.arena.renew.hood.text: That one looks a bit like you. In a hood.
robot.arena.renew.hood.source: That one looks a bit like you. In a hood.

robot.arena.renew.ticking.text: Something here ticks louder than I do. Be careful with time in this place.
robot.arena.renew.ticking.source: Something here ticks louder than I do. Be careful with time in this place.

robot.arena.mansk.museum.text: A museum! Paintings, a stage, and a mask that is looking at us.
robot.arena.mansk.museum.source: A museum! Paintings, a stage, and a mask that is looking at us.

robot.arena.mansk.hollow.text: There is nobody behind it. It is hollow, so do not let it breathe you in.
robot.arena.mansk.hollow.source: There is nobody behind it. It is hollow, so do not let it breathe you in.

robot.arena.slomo.night.text: It is night here, and everything is slime. Everything!
robot.arena.slomo.night.source: It is night here, and everything is slime. Everything!

robot.arena.slomo.mounds.text: Slime is slow to wade through. Keep to the mounds when you can.
robot.arena.slomo.mounds.source: Slime is slow to wade through. Keep to the mounds when you can.

robot.arena.monteur.stone.text: A moose, made of stone! And stones float between its antlers.
robot.arena.monteur.stone.source: A moose, made of stone! And stones float between its antlers.

robot.arena.monteur.wall.text: When he lowers his head, jump aside. If he runs into a wall, he gets dizzy!
robot.arena.monteur.wall.source: When he lowers his head, jump aside. If he runs into a wall, he gets dizzy!

robot.arena.sollmeldon.heads.text: Three heads! And all of him is mud. Black, sticky mud.
robot.arena.sollmeldon.heads.source: Three heads! And all of him is mud. Black, sticky mud.

robot.arena.sollmeldon.uphill.text: If the ground tips, get up high. The mud runs downhill, and there it gets deep.
robot.arena.sollmeldon.uphill.source: If the ground tips, get up high. The mud runs downhill, and there it gets deep.

robot.arena.qualmos.grin.text: So many tentacles, and it is grinning at us. This is the bottom of everything, and it lives here.
robot.arena.qualmos.grin.source: So many tentacles, and it is grinning at us. This is the bottom of everything, and it lives here.

robot.arena.qualmos.tricks.text: It gets angrier every time it is hurt, and learns a new trick. Be ready for anything!
robot.arena.qualmos.tricks.source: It gets angrier every time it is hurt, and learns a new trick. Be ready for anything!

robot.boss.gusto.inhale.text: It is breathing in! Step sideways, out of its breath!
robot.boss.gusto.inhale.source: It is breathing in! Step sideways, out of its breath!

robot.boss.gusto.stuck.text: Ha, flat on its face! Now, quick!
robot.boss.gusto.stuck.source: Ha, flat on its face! Now, quick!

robot.boss.gusto.split.text: There are three of it now! Only one is real, the others pop at a touch.
robot.boss.gusto.split.source: There are three of it now! Only one is real, the others pop at a touch.

robot.boss.gusto.vortex.text: Wind! Get out of its way!
robot.boss.gusto.vortex.source: Wind! Get out of its way!

robot.boss.totnar.throw.text: Skulls! And they bite when they land!
robot.boss.totnar.throw.source: Skulls! And they bite when they land!

robot.boss.totnar.gloom.text: It is getting dark. Stay close to me.
robot.boss.totnar.gloom.source: It is getting dark. Stay close to me.

robot.boss.totnar.skull.text: A skull came off! Look, you can see his heart.
robot.boss.totnar.skull.source: A skull came off! Look, you can see his heart.

robot.boss.totnar.roll.text: He is rolling! Get out of the way, then hit him while he is dizzy.
robot.boss.totnar.roll.source: He is rolling! Get out of the way, then hit him while he is dizzy.

robot.boss.totnar.last.text: Only one skull left, and he is angry. Watch the ground for rings.
robot.boss.totnar.last.source: Only one skull left, and he is angry. Watch the ground for rings.

robot.boss.totnar.storm.text: Clouds over you! Step out of the rings!
robot.boss.totnar.storm.source: Clouds over you! Step out of the rings!

robot.boss.squarlo.blow.text: A jet of water! Step out of the way.
robot.boss.squarlo.blow.source: A jet of water! Step out of the way.

robot.boss.squarlo.tide.text: He is calling the tide! Up a hill, quick!
robot.boss.squarlo.tide.source: He is calling the tide! Up a hill, quick!

robot.boss.squarlo.rest.text: He is out of breath! Now is your chance!
robot.boss.squarlo.rest.source: He is out of breath! Now is your chance!

robot.boss.squarlo.grow.text: He is growing. He is growing a lot!
robot.boss.squarlo.grow.source: He is growing. He is growing a lot!

robot.boss.squarlo.stomp.text: Watch the shadow of his foot! When it gets stuck, hit it.
robot.boss.squarlo.stomp.source: Watch the shadow of his foot! When it gets stuck, hit it.

robot.boss.squarlo.jump.text: He is jumping! Keep running, his shadow is slower than you.
robot.boss.squarlo.jump.source: He is jumping! Keep running, his shadow is slower than you.

robot.boss.squarlo.cannon.text: Water cannon! Right up close, it cannot reach you.
robot.boss.squarlo.cannon.source: Water cannon! Right up close, it cannot reach you.

robot.boss.flip.throw.text: A ball of light! Dodge it!
robot.boss.flip.throw.source: A ball of light! Dodge it!

robot.boss.flip.turn.text: Hold on! The whole world is turning!
robot.boss.flip.turn.source: Hold on! The whole world is turning!

robot.boss.flip.holes.text: After a turn, the holes in the floor crack open. Step off them, quick!
robot.boss.flip.holes.source: After a turn, the holes in the floor crack open. Step off them, quick!

robot.boss.flip.spin.text: His rings are spinning so fast! Something is about to change.
robot.boss.flip.spin.source: His rings are spinning so fast! Something is about to change.

robot.boss.flip.hole.text: A black hole! Run away from it, it pulls!
robot.boss.flip.hole.source: A black hole! Run away from it, it pulls!

robot.boss.foggery.rising.text: The lava is rising! Up the tower, go, go!
robot.boss.foggery.rising.source: The lava is rising! Up the tower, go, go!

robot.boss.foggery.eye.text: Did he just throw his eye at us?
robot.boss.foggery.eye.source: Did he just throw his eye at us?

robot.boss.foggery.faces.text: Fire-faces, out of his mouth. Of course.
robot.boss.foggery.faces.source: Fire-faces, out of his mouth. Of course.

robot.boss.foggery.curl.text: He is curling up into a ball...
robot.boss.foggery.curl.source: He is curling up into a ball...

robot.boss.foggery.cats.text: Cats! His shield holds while they live, so beat the cats first.
robot.boss.foggery.cats.source: Cats! His shield holds while they live, so beat the cats first.

robot.boss.foggery.geyser.text: Cracks under you! Move before they burst!
robot.boss.foggery.geyser.source: Cracks under you! Move before they burst!

robot.boss.foggery.platforms.text: The lava is over the tower! Jump onto the platforms!
robot.boss.foggery.platforms.source: The lava is over the tower! Jump onto the platforms!

robot.boss.renew.like-you.text: He fights like you do! He even rolls away like you.
robot.boss.renew.like-you.source: He fights like you do! He even rolls away like you.

robot.boss.renew.backwards.text: Wait, wait! Time is running backwards!
robot.boss.renew.backwards.source: Wait, wait! Time is running backwards!

robot.boss.renew.bow.text: He has a bow now. Step aside while he draws!
robot.boss.renew.bow.source: He has a bow now. Step aside while he draws!

robot.boss.renew.spiders.text: Spiders, falling out of the sky!
robot.boss.renew.spiders.source: Spiders, falling out of the sky!

robot.boss.renew.echo.text: Again! And the pale one is you. Do not stand where you stood before!
robot.boss.renew.echo.source: Again! And the pale one is you. Do not stand where you stood before!

robot.boss.renew.echoes.text: Your echoes are piling up. Keep moving!
robot.boss.renew.echoes.source: Your echoes are piling up. Keep moving!

robot.boss.renew.out.text: He is out of time! I think.
robot.boss.renew.out.source: He is out of time! I think.

robot.boss.mansk.inhale.text: He is breathing in! Step to the side, out of his mouth's way!
robot.boss.mansk.inhale.source: He is breathing in! Step to the side, out of his mouth's way!

robot.boss.mansk.spit.text: Ew. He spat you out. Are you sticky?
robot.boss.mansk.spit.source: Ew. He spat you out. Are you sticky?

robot.boss.mansk.orbs.text: Balls of light! They burst where the rings are, so get out of the rings.
robot.boss.mansk.orbs.source: Balls of light! They burst where the rings are, so get out of the rings.

robot.boss.mansk.flying.text: He is flying! Up there, only a bow or a staff can reach him.
robot.boss.mansk.flying.source: He is flying! Up there, only a bow or a staff can reach him.

robot.boss.mansk.slow.text: Everything is slow... even my gears...
robot.boss.mansk.slow.source: Everything is slow... even my gears...

robot.boss.mansk.horns.text: His horns broke! Ribbons... careful, they grab.
robot.boss.mansk.horns.source: His horns broke! Ribbons... careful, they grab.

robot.boss.mansk.lash.text: Do not get tangled in his ribbons!
robot.boss.mansk.lash.source: Do not get tangled in his ribbons!

robot.boss.mansk.whirl.text: He is spinning! Get away from him!
robot.boss.mansk.whirl.source: He is spinning! Get away from him!

robot.boss.slomo.arm.text: He threw a slug! It wants to sit on your head!
robot.boss.slomo.arm.source: He threw a slug! It wants to sit on your head!

robot.boss.slomo.meteor.text: Do not look up, look down: watch for the shadows!
robot.boss.slomo.meteor.source: Do not look up, look down: watch for the shadows!

robot.boss.slomo.flood.text: Slime coming in! Up on a mound!
robot.boss.slomo.flood.source: Slime coming in! Up on a mound!

robot.boss.slomo.burst.text: The blob burst! It was a slug the whole time.
robot.boss.slomo.burst.source: The blob burst! It was a slug the whole time.

robot.boss.slomo.spit.text: Slime balls! They slow you down.
robot.boss.slomo.spit.source: Slime balls! They slow you down.

robot.boss.slomo.slimes.text: More slime. He is making friends.
robot.boss.slomo.slimes.source: More slime. He is making friends.

robot.boss.monteur.throw.text: He throws the stones from his antlers! Keep moving.
robot.boss.monteur.throw.source: He throws the stones from his antlers! Keep moving.

robot.boss.monteur.charge.text: Head down, here he comes! Jump out of the way!
robot.boss.monteur.charge.source: Head down, here he comes! Jump out of the way!

robot.boss.monteur.stuck.text: He crashed! Hit him now, it hurts him double!
robot.boss.monteur.stuck.source: He crashed! Hit him now, it hurts him double!

robot.boss.monteur.summon.text: Moose, coming up out of the floor!
robot.boss.monteur.summon.source: Moose, coming up out of the floor!

robot.boss.monteur.sun.text: He is crumbling... into a sun made of stone?
robot.boss.monteur.sun.source: He is crumbling... into a sun made of stone?

robot.boss.monteur.rain.text: Stones from the sky! Watch for their shadows!
robot.boss.monteur.rain.source: Stones from the sky! Watch for their shadows!

robot.boss.monteur.spin.text: The world is turning! Do not worry, the floor stays under your feet.
robot.boss.monteur.spin.source: The world is turning! Do not worry, the floor stays under your feet.

robot.boss.monteur.mountain.text: The floor is cracking! Hold on, a mountain is coming up!
robot.boss.monteur.mountain.source: The floor is cracking! Hold on, a mountain is coming up!

robot.boss.sollmeldon.bite.text: A head is coming! The one that pulls back is the one that bites.
robot.boss.sollmeldon.bite.source: A head is coming! The one that pulls back is the one that bites.

robot.boss.sollmeldon.spit.text: Mud balls! They stay where they land, so mind your feet.
robot.boss.sollmeldon.spit.source: Mud balls! They stay where they land, so mind your feet.

robot.boss.sollmeldon.rain.text: He is flying! And dropping mud on us from up there!
robot.boss.sollmeldon.rain.source: He is flying! And dropping mud on us from up there!

robot.boss.sollmeldon.squirtles.text: Something is crawling out of the mud!
robot.boss.sollmeldon.squirtles.source: Something is crawling out of the mud!

robot.boss.sollmeldon.two.text: His head came off! Only two left.
robot.boss.sollmeldon.two.source: His head came off! Only two left.

robot.boss.sollmeldon.one.text: Another one! Just one head now, and it is angry.
robot.boss.sollmeldon.one.source: Another one! Just one head now, and it is angry.

robot.boss.sollmeldon.tilt.text: The whole world is tipping! Run uphill, away from the mud!
robot.boss.sollmeldon.tilt.source: The whole world is tipping! Run uphill, away from the mud!

robot.boss.qualmos.grab.text: An arm! Step back before it grabs you!
robot.boss.qualmos.grab.source: An arm! Step back before it grabs you!

robot.boss.qualmos.rage.text: It is furious! Stay back until it calms down.
robot.boss.qualmos.rage.source: It is furious! Stay back until it calms down.

robot.boss.qualmos.jet.text: A jet of water! Step out of it sideways.
robot.boss.qualmos.jet.source: A jet of water! Step out of it sideways.

robot.boss.qualmos.dive.text: It is leaping at you! Move!
robot.boss.qualmos.dive.source: It is leaping at you! Move!

robot.boss.qualmos.ink.text: Ink! It slows you down, so keep out of its way.
robot.boss.qualmos.ink.source: Ink! It slows you down, so keep out of its way.

robot.boss.qualmos.spin.text: All its tentacles at once! Get away from it!
robot.boss.qualmos.spin.source: All its tentacles at once! Get away from it!

robot.boss.qualmos.pull.text: It is pulling you in! Run the other way, hard!
robot.boss.qualmos.pull.source: It is pulling you in! Run the other way, hard!

robot.boss.qualmos.spines.text: Spines, three at once! Step between them!
robot.boss.qualmos.spines.source: Spines, three at once! Step between them!

robot.boss.qualmos.wave.text: A big wave! It will shove you, so brace yourself.
robot.boss.qualmos.wave.source: A big wave! It will shove you, so brace yourself.

robot.boss.qualmos.flop.text: It is puffing up! Get out from under it, then hit it while it lies there!
robot.boss.qualmos.flop.source: It is puffing up! Get out from under it, then hit it while it lies there!

robot.beaten.gusto.open.text: We did it! The well is open!
robot.beaten.gusto.open.source: We did it! The well is open!

robot.beaten.gusto.before.text: I think I have followed somebody down a well before. I cannot remember who.
robot.beaten.gusto.before.source: I think I have followed somebody down a well before. I cannot remember who.

robot.beaten.totnar.light.text: The light is back! I did not like that one.
robot.beaten.totnar.light.source: The light is back! I did not like that one.

robot.beaten.totnar.tower.text: A tower with no roof... I remember a tower with no roof. Then it is gone again.
robot.beaten.totnar.tower.source: A tower with no roof... I remember a tower with no roof. Then it is gone again.

robot.beaten.squarlo.drain.text: The water is draining away. You can stop holding your breath.
robot.beaten.squarlo.drain.source: The water is draining away. You can stop holding your breath.

robot.beaten.squarlo.tide.text: Water inside glass, with a tide... I have seen that before. From high above.
robot.beaten.squarlo.tide.source: Water inside glass, with a tide... I have seen that before. From high above.

robot.beaten.flip.right-way.text: The world is the right way up again! I think. Is it?
robot.beaten.flip.right-way.source: The world is the right way up again! I think. Is it?

robot.beaten.flip.lines.text: I used to fly between things that hung in the sky. Lots of them, on lines of light.
robot.beaten.flip.lines.source: I used to fly between things that hung in the sky. Lots of them, on lines of light.

robot.beaten.foggery.drain.text: The lava is draining away. My glass was getting nervous.
robot.beaten.foggery.drain.source: The lava is draining away. My glass was getting nervous.

robot.beaten.foggery.furnace.text: There was a furnace once, a small one, and someone very quick with hot glass. Was that my glass?
robot.beaten.foggery.furnace.source: There was a furnace once, a small one, and someone very quick with hot glass. Was that my glass?

robot.beaten.renew.sky.text: He went up into the sky. I hope he finds more time up there.
robot.beaten.renew.sky.source: He went up into the sky. I hope he finds more time up there.

robot.beaten.renew.name.text: If I could turn time back, only a little, I would go and find my name.
robot.beaten.renew.name.source: If I could turn time back, only a little, I would go and find my name.

robot.beaten.mansk.nobody.text: The mask fell over. There really was nobody inside.
